head: 30d35fba6819ab4238b40a31040051b06752600d
title: Balance lock release runs on the request context, so a cancelled request leaves the lock held until TTL

bugs.note: Unlock sends the Redis delete on the caller's context. When the request is cancelled or times out the delete never runs, the error is only logged, and the balance stays locked until the key expires, so every transaction on that balance fails to acquire the lock in the meantime.
